reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Re-established curriculum and progression from the adopted 2026–2027 Chemistry TER pp. 1 and 4–6, then reread dated Ocasys course descriptions and active UCR workbook evidence before revisiting the frozen alignments, schedule, audience text and description selections.
findings: Chemistry of Life is the first formal specialisation without a designated default. The 180 EC comprise 60 EC first year plus 50 EC upper core, 20 EC specialisation, 5 EC practical, 15 EC project and 30 EC minor. Second-year entry depends on positive study advice. The first year and 130 EC precede the experimental project and prior approvals apply. The minor remains open.

Basic spectroscopy and chemical analysis justify the limited Concepts of Chemistry alignment. The biomolecule introduction does not adequately correspond to general molecular structure and reactivity. Chemical Biology uses chemical tools and modification; Pharmacology is a distinct study of drug action. Metabolism and biomass conversion differ from renewable system design. Biochemistry, cellular processes, molecular laboratories and quantitative foundations remain meaningful overlaps.

The revised molecular-life-science option has biochemical, molecular laboratory and biomedical depth with chemistry and materials foundations. The environmental option integrates geochemistry, materials recovery, soils and Earth resources with quantitative modelling. Signals and Fourier methods contribute quantitative depth. The programmes differ by 11 courses and 82.5 EC in each direction. UCR does not provide a coherent third option in synthesis and specialist physical, inorganic and analytical chemistry.

The caution view, two concepts, course and comparator labels, links, explanatory and cell notes and all selected description texts match the record and checked sources. Optional independent research is shown alongside the external research project, outside scheduled credits.
